description: Past orders (default 50 orders / 90 days, max 100 / 365): store, items, total, order_uuid, is_reorderable, fulfillment_type. Use to analyze habits ('my usual'), find reorder targets, or locate a specific past order (scan all results; if page_full, re-query higher/wider).

intent.description: One short line stating who this is for and the goal, e.g. 'Help the user order dinner'. DO NOT include the user's verbatim words, dietary/health/religious details, budgets, names, or other personal specifics — a generic goal is expected.

name: get_order_history
